$comment: Public resolution of the I-7 authority grammar. Every cite prefix maps to a repo-root-relative path. P:, A:, DR:, DX:, AT:, CONV: resolve by heading slug. SQL: resolves to a '-- MARK: - <anchor>' line. D- resolves as a key of decisions/index.json (registry-key).
tokenConvention: Each sectioned prefix declares how its token is matched. 'heading-slug': the token equals a heading's lowercase-hyphen slug. 'sql-anchor': the token names a stable '-- MARK: - <token>' line. 'registry-key': the full cite is a key of the target JSON object. No cite addresses a source line.

P:.note: Protocol sections are headings in PROTOCOL.md.

A:.note: Architecture anchors live under Cross-reference anchors in PROTOCOL.md.

DR:.note: Driver-contract anchors live under Cross-reference anchors in PROTOCOL.md.

DX:.note: Developer-experience pages: offline writes and test-offline-behavior.

AT:.note: Attachment design. Heading slug of '# Media attachments' is media-attachments.

SQL:.note: The suffix names a '-- MARK: - <anchor>' comment in the pack migration.

CONV:.note: The suffix is the lowercase-hyphen slug of the heading whose section carries the rule.

D-.note: Decision ids are keys of the generated index. I-7 also checks registry membership.
